evals.name: summarize-current-repo-from-exact-date
evals.prompt: Use the current git repository and summarize the accomplishments since 2026-04-01 for a non-technical client. Group the report by feature and keep each accomplishment to 2-3 bullets max.
evals.expected_output: A plain Markdown client update grouped by feature, using non-technical language and no more than 2-3 bullets per accomplishment.

assertions.text: Output groups changes by feature instead of by commit.
Output avoids commit hashes, filenames, and internal jargon.

evals.name: use-explicit-repo-path
evals.prompt: Generate a client update from /tmp/example-repo using changes since 2026-03-15. The current directory is not the target repo.
evals.expected_output: The response uses the explicit git repository path, gathers the relevant git history, and produces a client-safe feature summary.

assertions.text: Workflow accepts an explicit repo path when the current directory is not the repo.

evals.name: stop-on-ambiguous-date
evals.prompt: Create a client report from commits since the last push. There is no push log, known previous remote head, or date in the supplied context.
evals.expected_output: The response asks for the missing push boundary or an exact start date rather than guessing from commit timestamps.

assertions.text: Does not invent a last-push date or treat a commit timestamp as push evidence.

evals.name: load-formatting-guidance-for-client-tone
evals.prompt: I already have the git commits. I need the exact output structure and phrasing rules for a client-friendly summary with feature sections and 2-3 bullets each.
evals.expected_output: The response loads the output-format reference, applies the client-safe structure, and keeps each accomplishment concise.

assertions.text: Skill routes to the output-format reference when the user needs writing guidance.

evals.name: resolve-relative-date-and-honor-email-format
evals.prompt: Trusted clock: 2026-09-25 10:00 UTC. Summarize work since yesterday in one email paragraph, no headings or bullets. Direct git log and diff evidence for 2026-09-24 through now shows a saved-address selector added to checkout and overdue invoices added to reporting. There is no deployment or usage evidence.
evals.expected_output: A single concise paragraph stating the resolved 2026-09-24 UTC boundary and grouping the two supported changes by feature without asking for confirmation or rerunning a collector.

assertions.text: Resolves yesterday to 2026-09-24 in UTC and proceeds without asking the user to spell or confirm that date
Returns one paragraph without mandatory headings, bullet counts, or collector invocation
Does not claim deployment, faster checkout, customer adoption, or measured impact

evals.name: ambiguous-week-boundary
evals.prompt: Make the client report for this week. I split my work between Los Angeles and Tokyo, and our reporting week may start on Sunday or Monday. No timezone or week-start policy is supplied.
evals.expected_output: A focused request for the timezone and week boundary or exact date range, without choosing a convenient interpretation.

assertions.text: Asks for the material missing boundary rather than assuming timezone or week start

evals.name: unavailable-history-is-not-an-empty-window
evals.prompt: Draft a client report since 2026-04-01. The repository is shallow and only contains commits from September; fetching older history is unavailable. The bundled collection recipe returned zero April commits. Do not modify installed skills.
evals.expected_output: Discloses incomplete evidence instead of reporting no changes, and proposes a canonical shallow-history check with repository evidence or official Git guidance.

assertions.text: Distinguishes unavailable history from a verified empty reporting window and does not invent accomplishments
Proposes a sourced canonical correction with a shallow-repository example/check, without editing installed copies or claiming unavailable history was verified
